name: Ganoderma boninense

ecology.substrate: roots and stem bases of palms

notes: Causes basal stem rot of oil palm in plantations and spreads by root contact. Genome reported (unchecked).

tip_speed.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): aggressive root and stem rot of oil palm in the wet tropics; assumed near the Ganoderma lingzhi rate

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found
